author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Elongated even-width cucumber on the diagonal with round ends and a short stem at the upper tip, as in the reference; the current drawing was a fat lumpy body with two dots, which read as a potato or a face.
omissions: The reference's short surface dashes are left out: the 14-wide body has no room for a dash 8 units from both flanks, and dots made it read as a potato.
